settings.content: Shows Subtotal, Shipping and Total in the cart drawer and on the cart page. When disabled, the default cart total is shown.

settings.label: Shipping cost source
settings.info: Live rates use your Shopify shipping settings and show the cheapest rate for the shopper's address.

settings.label: Delivery fee
settings.info: Fixed mode only. Numbers only (eg. 4.95). For multiple currencies use CODE:amount pairs (eg. USD:4.95,EUR:4.50). Leave empty to show only the total.

settings.label: Free shipping minimum amount
settings.info: Numbers only (eg. 50). For multiple currencies use CODE:amount pairs (eg. USD:50,EUR:60,JPY:9000). Leave empty to disable.

settings.label: Default country (live mode)
settings.info: English country name, eg. Germany. Leave empty to use the shopper's market country.

settings.label: Postal code required message
settings.default: Enter your postal code to see shipping costs.

settings.label: No rates message
settings.default: No shipping options available for this address.

settings.label: Error message
settings.default: We couldn't calculate shipping for this address.

settings.content: Conversion-optimized cart drawer: dark header, delivery promise, free shipping progress, social proof, savings badges and a secure checkout CTA. Requires Cart > Cart type = Drawer. Totals use "SC – Cart shipping breakdown", icons use "SC – Payment icons bar".

settings.label: Title
settings.info: Leave empty to use the theme's default cart title.

settings.label: Text
settings.default: Your items arrive at your door in 1-3 working days

settings.label: Free shipping minimum amount
settings.info: Numbers only (eg. 50) or CODE:amount pairs (eg. USD:50,EUR:60). Leave empty to use the minimum from "SC – Cart shipping breakdown".

settings.label: Heading (optional)
settings.info: Shown above the message until free shipping is reached, eg. "Almost there".

settings.label: Progress message
settings.info: [amount] is replaced with the remaining amount.

settings.label: Customer names
settings.info: Initials are shown in place of avatars that are not uploaded.

settings.label: Show compare-at price and savings badge
Savings badge
settings.info: [amount] is replaced with the saved amount.

settings.label: Button label
settings.info: Leave empty to use the theme's default checkout label.

settings.content: Product recommendations below the cart items. Products come from the product metafield custom.cart_upsell (list of products) of each cart item; if none apply, the fallback list below is used. Products already in the cart and sold-out products are skipped.

settings.label: Show cart upsell
settings.info: When off, the markup is still output but hidden. For an A/B test variant, show it with: .sc-cu { display: block !important; }

settings.label: Show teaser text
settings.info: Uses the product metafield custom.teaser, otherwise the start of the description.

settings.label: Show reviews
settings.info: Uses the standard reviews.rating and reviews.rating_count metafields filled by most review apps.

settings.label: Savings text
settings.info: [amount] is replaced with the saved amount.

settings.label: Background
settings.info: Leave empty for transparent.

settings.content: Payment icons shown on the product page, cart page and cart drawer (only when the cart has items). On the product page, add the "SC – Payment icons bar" block to place it.

settings.label: Icon source

options.label: Static – show the selected icons below
Dynamic – show the payment methods active in your store

settings.info: Dynamic reads Settings → Payments automatically and ignores the selection below.

settings.label: Icon order
settings.default: paypal, klarna, visa, master, amazon, apple_pay, google_pay
settings.info: Comma-separated, used in both modes. Keys: paypal, klarna, visa, master, amazon, apple_pay, google_pay, american_express, klarna-pay-later, sofort, bitcoin, shopify_pay, twint. Unlisted methods follow at the end.

settings.content: Free gift progress bar for the cart page and the cart drawer. Customers see how much more they need to spend to unlock a free gift. Setup guide: docs/sc-cart-free-gift-progress-setup.md

settings.label: Enable free gift
settings.info: Master switch for the cart page and cart drawer. Use it for A/B tests.

settings.label: Display section
settings.info: Uncheck to hide the bar but keep its markup (gifts are still handled). For an A/B test variant, show it with: .sc-fg--off { display: block !important; }

settings.label: Show in cart drawer
settings.info: Needs Cart type: Drawer (Theme settings → Cart).

settings.label: Hide when the cart is empty
Hide when the gift is sold out
Free gift minimum amount
settings.info: In your store's default currency, e.g. 100 = 100.00. Converted automatically for other markets.

settings.label: Amount that counts towards the minimum
settings.info: The gift's own value never counts towards the minimum.

settings.label: More gift choices (optional)
settings.info: The customer can pick one gift. Auto add uses the first available gift product.

settings.label: Gift pricing
settings.info: Selecting a product does not make it free. Use a 0.00 gift product (tag it hidden) or a Shopify automatic discount.

settings.label: Auto add
settings.info: Adds the gift as soon as the minimum is reached. When off, customers get an "Add free gift" button.

settings.label: If the customer removes the auto-added gift
Remove gift when cart drops below minimum
settings.info: Recommended. If off, a customer could keep a free gift without reaching the minimum.

settings.label: Round converted minimum up to a whole number
settings.info: Only for other currencies, e.g. 108.43 becomes 109.00.

settings.label: After the gift is added or removed

settings.content: Adds a free shipping marker to the same bar. Make sure your shipping rates give free shipping from this amount.

settings.label: Message when free shipping is the last milestone reached
Free shipping icon (SVG code)
settings.info: Optional. Leave empty for the truck icon.

settings.content: Offered once a first gift is in the cart. Uses the same gift pricing as the first gift: products priced 0.00, or an automatic discount you create in Shopify for this minimum.

settings.label: Message before the second gift
settings.default: Add [amount] more to unlock a second free gift!

settings.label: Message when the second gift is unlocked
settings.default: Congratulations! You've unlocked a second free gift!

settings.label: Second gift icon (SVG code)
settings.info: Optional. Leave empty for the gift icon.

settings.label: Progress bar gift icon (SVG code)
settings.info: Used when Icon is "Custom SVG code". Only shapes are kept; scripts, links and styles are removed for safety.

settings.label: Custom icon image
settings.info: Used when Icon is "Custom image".

settings.content: Placeholders: [amount] = amount still needed, [threshold] = minimum amount, [gift] = gift product name.

settings.label: Locked message
settings.default: Add [amount] more to unlock your free gift!

settings.label: Unlocked message
settings.default: Congratulations! You've unlocked your free gift!

settings.label: Gift added message
settings.default: Your free gift has been added to your cart.

settings.label: Gift removed message
settings.default: Your free gift was removed because your cart is below [threshold].

settings.label: Gift sold out message
settings.default: The free gift is currently out of stock.

settings.label: Error message
settings.default: We couldn't add your free gift. Please try again.

settings.label: Custom gift image
settings.info: Optional. Defaults to the gift product image.

settings.label: Show crossed-out gift value
settings.info: Automatic discount: shows the product price. 0.00 product: shows its compare-at price, if set.
